text: I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me your age and if you have any known history of cancer, tuberculosis, or recent weight loss beyond what you mentioned. Also, have you had any fever or night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; the significant weight loss and night sweats are concerning. Given your enlarged supraclavicular lymph node and abdominal pain, have you experienced any recent travel to endemic areas, exposure to tuberculosis, or changes in bowel habits? Also, do you have any history of alcohol use or liver disease?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: The fact that the lymph node is "fixed" and painless is a highly concerning sign for malignancy.
